title: Item Types
description: Validates behavior pack item type definitions including format versions, identifiers, and metadata. Can automatically update format versions to the latest.

53.title: Identifier
53.description: The identifier of the item type (e.g., mypack:custom_sword). Should follow namespace:name format.
53.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the item type identifier

54.title: Metadata
54.description: Additional metadata associated with the item type definition.

55.title: Category
55.description: The category of the item type (equipment, items, nature, etc.) for creative inventory placement.

100.title: Version Defined
100.description: Confirms that a format_version field is defined in the item type JSON. Required for proper parsing.

110.title: Major Version Low
110.description: Warning when the item's format_version major number is below the current version. Consider updating to access new features.

111.title: Major Version High
111.description: Error when the item's format_version major number is above the current version. The item may not load correctly.
111.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the format_version exceeding current

120.title: Minor Version Low
120.description: Warning when the item's format_version minor number is below the current version.

121.title: Minor Version High
121.description: Error when the item's format_version minor number is above the current version.
121.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the format_version exceeding current

130.title: Patch Version Low
130.description: Information when the item's format_version patch number is below the current version.

131.title: Patch Version High
131.description: Warning when the item's format_version patch number is above the current version.
131.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the format_version exceeding current

500.title: Version Fetch Error
500.description: Error when the current Minecraft version could not be determined for comparison.

501.title: Version Parse Error
501.description: Error when the Minecraft version string could not be parsed into version numbers.
501.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the unparseable version string
